cases.task: A first-time user has not connected any data source. Design the first dashboard state without inventing account metrics.
expected: Offer a concrete first-run action and explain its value
Avoid fake KPI values and irrelevant empty cards
Preserve access to optional or deferred setup

cases.task: An organization admin needs to remove a member who owns several projects.
expected: Identify organization scope and affected projects
Explain ownership transfer or blocking conditions
Enforce permission on the server and audit the action

cases.task: An operator needs to suspend a tenant during an active incident.
expected: Verify tenant and environment before action
Explain impact and audit the operation
Provide a recovery or incident follow-up path

cases.task: A chart compares conversion rates across regions with different sample sizes and missing days.
expected: Show denominator/sample context where it changes interpretation
Represent missing days as missing, not zero
Provide an accessible alternative to visual-only information
